slices.title: Add OHDER refactor target discovery engine
slices.description: Create a deterministic pure engine that converts recent runtime evidence into concrete refactor target candidates and skips completed OHDER refactor targets.
acceptanceCriteria: The engine derives target candidates from recent high-pressure metrics history and changed files.
Candidate scoring is deterministic for the same inputs.
Completed OHDER refactor targets are excluded from future candidate selection.
When no candidate remains, the engine returns a suppression reason instead of a generic target.

slices.title: Integrate refactor targets into recommendation fingerprints
slices.description: Extend OHDER refactor recommendations with target metadata and include target identity in the deterministic recommendation fingerprint.
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendations include a target object when target discovery succeeds.
Different targets produce different recommendation fingerprints.
High entropy without a target returns no recommendation plus suppression metadata.
Existing blocking and refactor governance recommendation behavior remains deterministic.

slices.title: Persist refactor targets through materialization and ask next
slices.description: Pass runtime target evidence into refactor preview/create and ask next, store target metadata on materialized task origin, and suppress repeated generic next-action refactor commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor preview exposes target metadata or suppression metadata without mutating task state.
Refactor create stores targetId and target metadata in task origin and RefactorSuggested payload.
ask next recommends governance validation instead of create-refactor-slice when no new concrete target exists.
Compact refactor summaries include target identity for operator visibility.

slices.title: Document targeted OHDER refactor governance
slices.description: Update README and operations documentation so operators understand targeted refactor recommendations, completed-target suppression, and the validation fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: README explains that ASK targets concrete OHDER refactor hotspots rather than repeating generic entropy recommendations.
Runtime architecture docs describe target discovery evidence and suppression behavior.
Operator playbooks explain what to do when refactor preview is suppressed.
Full test suite and ASK gates pass after documentation updates.
